pamphlet_excerpts: Accurate Observation Insect: The most accurate observation of an insect in nature comesfrom watching it undisturbed.
Observing Insects: When observing insects in theirhabitat, be careful to leave them unharmed in the place thatyou found them.
Seven Principles Leave: The Seven Principles of Leave No Trace and the Outdoor Code apply to alloutdoor activities, including insect study.
Requirements Insect Study: Requirements for the Insect Study merit badge call for you to not only observe insects, but in somecases, to collect them.
step_by_step_procedure: Trek Outdoors There: As with any trek in the outdoors, there are some basicguidelines to follow when searching for insects. 1.
Embark Insect Safari: When you embark on your insect safari, prepare a trip plan, or at the very least, tell an adult where you are going.
Isalso Idea Friend: It isalso a good idea to take a friend with you. 2.
Idea Wear Long: It is a good idea to wear long pants, a long-sleeved shirt, ahat, and closed shoes to keep ticks, chiggers, and insectsfrom biting you or hitching a ride.

pamphlet_excerpts: Monarch Butterfly Chrysalis: Monarch butterfly chrysalis The chrysalis is a shiny, transparent green with several spots of gold.
Hangs Leaf Several: It hangs from the leaf for several days to about three weeks, dependingon the weather.
Near End Period: Near the end of this period, the chrysalis turns very dark (almost black), and the wing pattern of the adult butterfly can be seenbeneath the thin skin.
Finally Bottom Chrysalis: Finally, the bottom of the chrysalis splits and out crawls the adultmonarch butterfly.
step_by_step_procedure: Its Wings Gradually: Its wings gradually expand and harden, and thebutterfly starts to use its long, hollow, coiled “tongue” to sucknectar from flowers.
Live Six Weeks: Usually, the adult will live four to six weeks, feeding occasionallybut mostly just wandering from field to field.
Last Brood Summer: The last brood of summer, however, will migrate south, often in large numbers and journeying anincredible 2,500 miles.
Brood Lives Longer: This brood lives longer, some of the monarchs livethrough the winter in Mexico or along the southern coast of California.

step_by_step_procedure: Among Insects Toarrive: Among the first insects toarrive on a newly dead bodyare blowflies, and a femaleblowfly usually lays eggs within a very short time after arriving.
Researcher Whoknows Long: A researcher whoknows how long it takes blowfly eggs to reach these differentstages can estimate the time of the victim’s death.
Few People Employed: Few people are employed full-time as forensic entomologists.
